Weave is a mobile-based professional networking application to arrange meetings and friendly discussions.

 
 It enables professionals to log into the application through their LinkedIn profiles, and the app then presents them with a stream of nearby professionals who are presumably open to face-to-face meetings and whom they can swipe “yes” or “no” to meet.
